summary: The United States conducted airstrikes against Iranian targets in Khuzestan, Bushehr, and Bandar Abbas, killing IRGC personnel and setting harbor vessels ablaze. Iran launched missiles toward Jordan, triggering sirens and a U.S. Embassy shelter-in-place order. Israel struck Gaza, seriously wounding Hamas spokesman Hazem Qassem and killing a PIJ weapons commander, while Defense Minister Katz declared readiness for renewed independent strikes on Iran.
key_points: U.S. airstrikes hit Khuzestan, Bushehr, and Bandar Abbas, killing at least three IRGC members and burning boats in Asaluyeh harbor. (Source: @shin_persian/7613, @Faytuks_Network/4788, @asafroz/51233)
Iran fired missiles toward Jordan, prompting sirens and a U.S. Embassy shelter-in-place directive for staff. (Source: @inon_yttach/9345, @Faytuks_Network/4783, @asafroz/51221)
Hamas spokesman Hazem Qassem critically wounded in an Israeli vehicle strike in Gaza City; his bodyguard killed. (Source: @yediotnews25/132492, @lelotsenzura/93457, @amitsegal/62929)
Attack on a checkpoint near Imam Reza shrine in Mashhad killed four Basij (unofficial reports: 10+ dead, 25 wounded); attackers fled. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/75405)
Israeli Defense Minister Katz stated IDF is prepared to resume campaign in Iran, regain air superiority, and conduct independent strikes. (Source: @manniefabian/58761)
Netanyahu and Trump spoke, coordinating on U.S. moves in the Gulf; Netanyahu raised concerns over Erdogan's rhetoric. (Source: @lelotsenzura/93461, @naya_foriraq/82259)
Qatar raised its security threat level, urging residents to stay in shelters; Kuwait held military-security coordination meeting. (Source: @pkpoi/143207, @rodast_omiddana/75388)
Israeli SIGINT aircraft (Nachshon Eitam) tracked operating over Palestine. (Source: @redlinkleb/30684)

sections.executive_summary: The United States conducted airstrikes against Iranian targets in Khuzestan, Bushehr, and Bandar Abbas, killing IRGC personnel and setting harbor vessels ablaze. Iran launched missiles toward Jordan, triggering sirens and a U.S. Embassy shelter-in-place order. Israel struck Gaza, seriously wounding Hamas spokesman Hazem Qassem and killing a PIJ weapons commander, while Defense Minister Katz declared readiness for renewed independent strikes on Iran.

points: U.S. airstrikes struck Khuzestan Province, killing three IRGC members: Second Lieutenant Hussein Amoori, Lieutenant Saeed Tavakkolizadeh, and Basij member Mohsen Nejati, per Iranian sources. (Source: @shin_persian/7613, @rodast_omiddana/75400)

In Bushehr Province, verified footage shows a harbor in Asaluyeh with multiple small boats ablaze following strikes; Iranian air defenses activated in Bushehr. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/4788, @New_security8200/202386, @asafroz/51233)

Explosions reported at Bandar Abbas port and Chabahar port dock; Iranian state media denied explosions in Bandar Abbas, Qeshm, Sirik, and Jask, but local sources reported blasts. (Source: @New_security8200/202384, @New_security8200/202385, @SharghDaily/170947, @kianmeli1/88646)

Iran launched missiles toward Jordan, triggering sirens across Jordan and a U.S. Embassy shelter-in-place order; reports indicate possible Iranian missile launches toward Jordan. (Source: @inon_yttach/9345, @Faytuks_Network/4783, @Faytuks_Network/4784, @asafroz/51221)
Missiles launched from near Qushchi (Lake Urmia area) and near Khomein, per local reports; naval base in Konarak targeted in two stages by fighter jets. (Source: @mamlekate/103851, @kianmeli1/88657)

Funeral processions held for Artesh (regular army) personnel killed in U.S. strikes two nights prior in Bandar Abbas; large crowds chanted anti-U.S. slogans in Mashhad. (Source: @kianmeli1/88654, @rasedal3ado138e/375891)
Shooting incident on Sarfarazan Boulevard in Mashhad (17 km from Imam Reza shrine) killed two; cause and identities unconfirmed. (Source: @SharghDaily/170960)

Defense Minister Israel Katz declared at pilot graduation that IDF is "alert and prepared for resumption of the campaign in Iran," ready to regain air superiority and conduct independent "blue-and-white" strikes. (Source: @manniefabian/58761)

Israeli strike in Gaza City targeted a vehicle, seriously wounding Hamas spokesman Hazem Qassem and killing his bodyguard; Hamas confirmed the attempt. (Source: @yediotnews25/132492, @lelotsenzura/93457, @amitsegal/62929)

IDF announced killing of Rashid al-Qadhi, Palestinian Islamic Jihad weapons production commander, in southern Gaza strike; also killed Hamas sniper Abdullah Baha al-Din Razak al-Souti in northern Gaza. (Source: @manniefabian/58760)
Israeli SIGINT aircraft (GLF5 Nachshon Eitam, call sign ROEM) tracked conducting electronic reconnaissance over Palestine at 32,325 ft. (Source: @redlinkleb/30684)

Netanyahu spoke with Trump, coordinating on U.S. moves in the Gulf; Netanyahu raised severity of Erdogan's rhetoric against Israel and need for security zones on borders. (Source: @lelotsenzura/93461)
Netanyahu stated war not over, new challenges emerging alongside old ones; preserving Israeli air superiority is a national security cornerstone. (Source: @amitsegal/62926)

IDF opened Route 10 in Paran Brigade area for weekends (Thursday-Saturday) until August 29, 2026, with restrictions; training continues in southern and northern fire zones. (Source: @idf_telegram/24579)

Hamas spokesman Hazem Qassem critically wounded in Israeli vehicle strike in Gaza City; bodyguard killed; Hamas confirmed assassination attempt. (Source: @yediotnews25/132492, @lelotsenzura/93457, @amitsegal/62929)

PIJ weapons production chief Rashid al-Qadhi killed in Israeli strike in southern Gaza; IDF said he played central role in manufacturing and supplying all weapons to PIJ military wing. (Source: @manniefabian/58760)
Hamas sniper Abdullah Baha al-Din Razak al-Souti killed in separate Israeli strike in northern Gaza; IDF said both operatives posed threat to forces. (Source: @manniefabian/58760)
Israeli forces blew up residential buildings in eastern Gaza City, per Palestinian reports. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/375897)
One Palestinian injured by stun grenade to head, another beaten during Israeli forces activity in Ramallah, West Bank. (Source: @lelotsenzura/93467)

Defense Minister Katz stated Israel did not ask permission to enter Lebanon and does not need permission to stay; will remain in security zone until Hezbollah disarmed across all Lebanon and threat to northern residents removed. (Source: @inon_yttach/9338)
Map references indicate focus on "Qalat Mays" and Damascus area, per tracking channel. (Source: @redlinkleb/30732, @redlinkleb/30726)
Iraqi fisherman died after detention by Kuwaiti coast guard; Iraqi Foreign Ministry confirmed. (Source: @naya_foriraq/82261)

U.S. Embassy in Jordan issued immediate shelter-in-place order due to reports of missiles, drones, or rockets in Jordanian airspace; sirens sounded in Jordan after launches from Iran. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/4783, @inon_yttach/9345, @asafroz/51221)
Qatar Interior Ministry raised security threat level, urging all to stay home and in shelters. (Source: @pkpoi/143207)
Kuwait Interior Ministry held coordination meeting of military and security agencies. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/75388)
Unconfirmed reports suggest Kuwait and Bahrain may have attacked Iran; claims of coastal bombardment for seizure of Iranian islands. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/75399)
Brief report of "hit in Bahrain" with no details. (Source: @lelotsenzura/93447)
Ships transiting Strait of Hormuz via Iranian path observed. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/375885)
Israeli Airport Authority confirmed no change in instructions; Ben Gurion and all Israeli airports operating normally with rising passenger traffic. (Source: @pkpoi/143217)

Iran launched missiles toward Jordan, triggering sirens and U.S. Embassy shelter-in-place order; Jordanian airspace reported active with missiles/drones. (Source: @inon_yttach/9345, @Faytuks_Network/4783, @asafroz/51221)
Hamas spokesman Hazem Qassem critically wounded in Israeli vehicle strike in Gaza City; bodyguard killed. (Source: @yediotnews25/132492, @lelotsenzura/93457)
Attack on Imam Reza shrine checkpoint in Mashhad killed four Basij (unofficial 10+ dead, 25 wounded); attackers at large. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/75405)
Israeli Defense Minister Katz declared IDF ready to resume campaign in Iran, conduct independent strikes to regain air superiority. (Source: @manniefabian/58761)
Netanyahu-Trump call coordinated on U.S. Gulf moves; Netanyahu raised Erdogan rhetoric and border security zones. (Source: @lelotsenzura/93461, @naya_foriraq/82259)

sections.threat_assessment: The conflict has escalated to direct U.S. kinetic action against Iranian territory, with strikes across multiple provinces killing IRGC personnel and damaging naval assets. Iran's missile response targeting Jordan indicates a broadening regional scope, drawing Gulf states into active threat postures. Israel is simultaneously conducting high-value targeted killings in Gaza (Hamas spokesman, PIJ weapons chief) while signaling readiness for a third round of independent strikes on Iran. The convergence of U.S. and Israeli operations, coupled with Iranian retaliation against U.S. partners, creates a high probability of further escalation across the Gulf, Levant, and Iranian homeland.
sections.regional_response: Gulf states are shifting to heightened alert: Qatar raised its threat level and ordered sheltering, Kuwait convened military-security coordination, and Jordan activated air defenses under U.S. embassy shelter orders. Unverified claims of Kuwaiti and Bahraini strikes on Iran suggest possible coordinated Gulf action, though unconfirmed. Russia's Lavrov called for a negotiated solution respecting all parties' interests. Iraqi authorities protested a fisherman's death in Kuwaiti custody, adding a bilateral irritant. Israeli civil aviation remains normal, but military readiness is publicly emphasized.
sections.intelligence_notes: The U.S. strikes appear focused on IRGC naval and coastal assets in Khuzestan and Bushehr, with verified harbor damage at Asaluyeh. Iran's missile launches toward Jordan — not Israel — signal a deliberate choice to pressure U.S. regional partners while avoiding direct Israeli retaliation triggers. The Mashhad shrine checkpoint attack and Mashhad shooting suggest internal security fragility amid the funeral period for the Supreme Leader. Israeli SIGINT flights over Palestine indicate persistent surveillance of Gaza and West Bank communications. The Netanyahu-Trump call confirms tight operational coordination, with Israel briefed on U.S. moves in real time.
